answer: A newcomer locks a refundable 280 POA bond for 110 days before work, so each fake identity costs 280 POA and eleven weeks a farm cannot run in parallel. It enters through one public inlet ledger listing its bond and every job, so a copied history shows at once. A sparrow check lands with no warning, one small live task due in 15 minutes, while three auditors drawn by lot replay one job a month. A missed check or a forged entry in the lantern record burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
